# General Practitioner Referral Letter

> A structured referral letter from primary care to a specialist or service. It records **who is being referred**, **who is referring**, **where and why**, and **how urgently**, then applies a documentation engine that grades the referral's **completeness** (Complete / Incomplete), classifies its **urgency** (routine / urgent / two-week-wait suspected cancer / emergency), and raises **flags** for safety-critical conditions.
